title: spec: a notify node's refused `title` / `message` is told to write `'{{record.name}}'`, the spelling the build's `flow-double-brace-interpolation` rule then flags on the same node and the notify renderer does not resolve
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named landing site and a measured reach**: a refusal message that ships in `@objectstack/spec` (the release-fixed wrong-text exception, reachability measured first). Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549, `session_01GV6oYwgc1kWiUCb1YaprQ7`) as the follow-up that PR #22063's ACCEPT `6034196850` named for its merge (contract review `6033880025`, escalation A). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What is measured (on `main` `d4680d2820`, the merge of PR #22063, in a scratch copy of the tree)

- **`NotifyConfigSchema.safeParse`**, the schema `FlowSchema` parses a notify node's config with:
  - a whitespace-only bare `title` is refused with `TYPED_EXPRESSION_SOURCE_REQUIRED.template`: "… Write `'{{record.name}}'` or `{ dialect: 'template', source: '{{record.name}}' }`.";
  - a numeric `title` is refused with `TYPED_EXPRESSION_DIALECT_ONLY.template`, ending in the same two prescriptions;
  - control: `title: 'Deal {record.name}'` parses.
- **`lintFlowPatterns`** on a one-node notify flow, the rule `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` run (`authoring-rules.ts`, `lintFlowPatterns`, `commands: ALL`):
  - `title: '{{record.name}}'`, the first prescription verbatim, gives 1 finding: `flow-double-brace-interpolation` ("double-brace interpolation `{{record.name}}` — flow node values use SINGLE braces.");
  - `title: { dialect: 'template', source: '{{record.name}}' }`, the second prescription verbatim, gives the same finding;
  - control: `title: '{record.name}'` gives 0 findings.

## Where it is

- `packages/spec/src/shared/expression.zod.ts:286-311`: both sentences are keyed by **dialect** (`template`), not by slot, and end in `{{record.name}}`. The `tmpl` tagged-template docblock (`:503`, "Mustache-template … `{{record.x}}`") says the same.
- Since PR #22063, a notify node's `title` / `message` are `template`-typed slots, so these sentences are now what a refused notify slot returns. The notify executor resolves single-brace `{token}` only (`interpolateString` in `service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts:348`). Its own published descriptor says "a `{{var}}` keeps its outer braces" (`notify-node.ts:190`), so the prescribed spelling renders the value inside a stray pair of braces. That is read from source, not run.
- The other `template` slots (the messaging and email renderers, per `TemplateExpressionInputSchema`'s docblock) do read `{{var}}`, so the sentence is right there. The defect is one sentence serving two brace conventions.

## Why it matters

A refusal message is the one place an author, human or AI, is told exactly what to write. Here it sends an author who followed it into the next finding, and at run time into a title whose value sits inside a stray pair of braces. The repo already met this split once, for `Object.titleFormat` (#15947, closed).

## Reader who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The landing site is `expression.zod.ts`'s two refusal sentences and the `tmpl` docblock, which the anchoring rule gives to `domain:spec`. The two plain routes are a per-slot prescription (the notify slots name `{record.name}`) or a sentence that names both conventions. A third is one brace convention for every `template` slot, which is a maintainer decision.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, closed included:
- 「notify title template refusal message prescribes double brace {{record.name}} but notify renderer interpolates single brace {token}」 → 4 hits; none is this. #22054 is the card PR #22063 closed, and #15947 is the `titleFormat` precedent.
- 「TYPED_EXPRESSION_SOURCE_REQUIRED TYPED_EXPRESSION_DIALECT_ONLY template sentence Mustache record.name flow node lint refuses double brace」 → 8 hits; none is this. #19939 (open, `target:v18`) retires the `{var}` dialect in flow **assignment** slots, not notify text.

Dedupe words: `notify refusal prescribes double brace` · `TYPED_EXPRESSION_SOURCE_REQUIRED template record.name` · `flow-double-brace-interpolation notify title`
